scripts.build: pnpm exec vite build && pnpm run check:bundle:prepared && pnpm exec tsc --build

scripts.check:bundle:relay-host: rm -rf ../../.tmp/relay-host-bundle && pnpm exec wrangler deploy --dry-run --config wrangler.jsonc scripts/relay-host-bundle-entry.mjs --outdir ../../.tmp/relay-host-bundle --metafile ../../.tmp/relay-host-bundle/meta.json && node scripts/assert-worker-bundle-clean.mjs ../../.tmp/relay-host-bundle ../../.tmp/relay-host-bundle/meta.json
scripts.test:node: pnpm exec vitest run --config vitest.node.config.ts src/index.test.ts src/browser-auth-env.test.ts src/owner-admin.test.ts src/configured-worker.test.ts src/owner-profile-worker.test.ts src/owner-qualification-runtime.test.ts src/owner-profile-d1-profile.test.ts src/relay-realm-imports.test.ts src/relay-config.test.ts src/relay-migrations.test.ts src/relay-admission-setup.test.ts src/relay-health-config.test.ts
scripts.test:worker: pnpm run check:bundle && pnpm run test:node && pnpm run test:native && pnpm run test:bindings && pnpm run test:auth-http
